document_title: CRYPTOCURRENCY IN THE NEW ECONOMY: PROBLEMS AND PROSPECTS
summary: An academic paper published in 2019 analyzing the economic nature, market dynamics, and regulatory challenges of cryptocurrencies with a focus on Kazakhstan. The study selects Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple, Litecoin, and Bitcoin Cash as the five largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization for analysis, presenting market capitalization data and period-over-period changes as of November 2018. The paper discusses factors affecting cryptocurrency prices, advantages and disadvantages of cryptocurrencies, and the legal and regulatory landscape in Kazakhstan and other countries. However, it does not make any actionable trading recommendations or present specific market-moving events.

events.title: Market capitalization data for major cryptocurrencies as of November 2018
events.body: The paper reports market capitalization and percentage changes for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple, Litecoin, and Bitcoin Cash over various periods ending November 2018. Bitcoin capitalization was $111.81B (down 43.81% year-over-year), Ethereum $21.788B (down 75.31% YoY), Ripple $20.027B (down 44.35% YoY), Bitcoin Cash $9.806B (down 56.03% YoY), and Litecoin $3.092B (down 75.13% YoY). The text notes overall cryptocurrency capitalization in the market is growing despite negative yearly comparisons.
